status: Seven whole frame/variant/cycle bodies reconstructed and verified offline; higher controller and complete animation playback remain unfinished.
changes: Replace uninitialized in_ECX with named C interfaces taking a typed animation-cycle receiver.
Canonical adapters capture ECX before C code and retain existing cdecl stack cleanup; new C callers must use the explicit interfaces.
Preserve signed16 frame normalization, low16 variant indexing, direct signed16 selected-frame assignment and finite-repeat counter reloads.
Small numeric x87 helpers preserve PC/RC, unordered comparison and comparison of extended intermediate before binary32 rounding; no original code executes.

verification.scope: 32 frame-normalization cases plus null variant;18 variant/frame and6 variant selections;216 forward/reverse cycle cases;96 step cases spanning PC24/53/64 and four rounding modes at sub-ULP boundaries;6 ordinary step cases. Every case compares original against canonical adapter and separately against named C API, memory, defined EAX, stack/nonvolatile registers, CW and balanced x87 TOP.
verification.limits: Well-formed pointers and positive frame counts. Zero-length nonterminating native loops, unmasked traps and FPSW equivalence are outside the verified domain. Higher controller55D4F0, action/direction selection and unreconstructed upstream callers are not certified; no live-game/physical-animation claim.

next: Reconstruct complete55D4F0 timing/return pipeline and its55D760/55D780/55D7B0/55D810 callers; Rea has already read their complete bodies.
publication: Sources pushed to main; no tag or GitHub release created. Exact tested EXE promoted to local Release.
